scripts.build: pnpm --filter @harfhane/shared run build && pnpm --parallel --filter "@harfhane/frontend" --filter "@harfhane/backend" run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @harfhane/shared run test && pnpm --filter @harfhane/ui-tokens run test && pnpm --filter @harfhane/frontend run test && pnpm --filter @harfhane/backend run test
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @harfhane/shared run build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm typecheck:test && pnpm lint && pnpm test
